selection_policy: One fixed configuration, declared before this model's public evaluation. No public-GT fitting, parameter search or score-driven revision.

rationale.short_team_changes: Require sustained opposing observations instead of accepting every nearest-player flip.
rationale.short_missing: A short observation gap is ambiguous, so it supplies no H-versus-A evidence and discourages inventing a stoppage.
rationale.long_missing: Long missing runs supply a weak dead-ball hypothesis, not a confirmed dead-ball label.
rationale.time_units: Observation costs accumulate per second, not once per correlated video frame. Switch penalties apply once per state change. Values are engineering priors, not measured football constants.
